outcome: cesarean delivery due to fetal distress
cohort: The study included 98 singleton pregnancies with epilepsy who delivered at a tertiary referral center between October 2022 and May 2025.
finding: Polytherapy in pregnant women with epilepsy was an independent predictor of Composite Adverse Perinatal Outcome (CAPO), leading to a significantly higher rate of CAPO, seizures during pregnancy, and lower birth weight compared to monotherapy.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery due to fetal distress was significantly more frequent in the polytherapy group compared to the monotherapy group.
